mutants.title: the no-arg dev-bin expose loop aborts at the first foreign refusal again, so units after it are never attempted while the caller's summary implies they ran
mutants.subject: scripts/dev-bin.sh
find:
rc=0; expose_one "$b" || rc=$?
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then exposed=$((exposed + 1)); else refused="$refused $b"; fi
replace:
rc=0; expose_one "$b" || rc=$?
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then exposed=$((exposed + 1)); else warn "[dev-bin] REFUSE aborts the loop"; exit 3; fi
